title: Sr VP, Operations
text:
**Join a Company That’s Redefining Air and Improving Lives**

At Broan-NuTone, we don’t just lead the residential ventilation industry in North America, we’re shaping its future. Through innovation, ingenuity, and a relentless focus on quality, we’re on a mission to be the most trusted and forward-thinking manufacturer of residential ventilation solutions.

Our impact is everywhere: in more than **110 million homes across North America**, where our products help families breathe easier every day. In fact, we move nearly **13 trillion cubic feet of fresh air annually**; a testament to the scale and significance of what we do.

Behind that impact are our **2,000+ entrepreneurs** working across four countries, driven by a shared passion for innovation and excellence. Our products are crafted in our three manufacturing facilities and supported by a network of trusted partners. Together, we bring to life a powerful portfolio of industry-leading brands, including **Broan-NuTone, Zephyr, BEST, and Venmar**.

**A Culture Built on Purpose and Values**

What truly sets us apart is how we work. Our Core Values, **Safety, Trust, Entrepreneurial Spirit, and Bias for Action**, guide every decision we make and every interaction we have. We’re proud to foster a collaborative, high-energy culture where ideas thrive, innovation is encouraged, and people feel empowered to make an impact.

Our purpose is simple yet powerful: **improving lives through better air.** Every product we create is designed to make homes healthier, more comfortable, and longer lasting; helping families flourish and giving professionals solutions they can trust. It’s meaningful work we can stand behind.

**Part of Something Bigger**

Founded in 1932, Broan-NuTone is a cornerstone of **Madison Air**, one of the fastest-growing companies transforming the future of air. In April 2026, Madison Air went public on the New York Stock Exchange (MAIR), reflecting its remarkable growth and momentum. Today, Madison Air includes:

* **8,000+ entrepreneurs worldwide**
* **$10 billion in enterprise value**
* **42 manufacturing facilities across 11 countries**

Together, we’re united by a bold mission: **to make the world safer, healthier, and more productive through the transformative power of air.**

**Ready to make your mark? Join us and help improve lives with better indoor air quality.**

**Business Job Title:** Sr VP - Operations

 

**Job Summary:** The Sr VP - Operations provides global leadership and oversight of Broan-NuTone’s factory operations and supply chain functions. This executive establishes and deploys the global operations and supply chain strategy, drives operational excellence, and determines the most profitable approach for meeting customer demand worldwide. As a member of the Executive Team, the role contributes to company vision and strategy while partnering with Product Development, Marketing, Sales, senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop and communicate a three-year global operations and supply chain strategy aligned with the business strategy.
* Lead strategy deployment and continue implementing a formal SIOP process across Broan-NuTone.
* Advise senior leaders on operational and supply chain improvements that strengthen service, cost, quality, and efficiency.
* Develop and implement manufacturing, materials, quality, productivity, and process-improvement plans.
* Own operating budgets, capital plans, cost-reduction initiatives, and monthly, quarterly, and annual operating results.
* Establish global SQDCI metrics and a standardized KPI reporting process.
* Target 98% on-time-and-complete delivery while improving safety, quality, material and labor productivity, and inventory performance.
* Execute global sourcing, logistics, and supply-side initiatives while monitoring manufacturing technology and supply chain trends.
* Align customer requirements, supplier capabilities, and performance metrics with key business objectives.
* Negotiate with and influence supplier partners to support corporate goals and create strategic advantage.
* Champion lean manufacturing and continuous improvement throughout the manufacturing enterprise.
* Design a responsive global operations organization, including supply chain planning, make-versus-buy decisions, and local-market service strategies.
* Build and develop a world-class operations and supply chain team through coaching, succession planning, and external hiring when needed.
* Maintain the technical capabilities required to meet customer and market requirements, with continued emphasis on safety and quality.
* Create a flexible, responsive, metrics-driven culture that can react quickly to changing market conditions.

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field required.
* MBA or master’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of successful leadership experience spanning manufacturing, strategic procurement, distribution, and logistics.
* Experience in a high-performing, global, complex durable-consumer-goods manufacturing company with at least $500 million in annual sales.
* Demonstrated responsibility for global operations and supply chain functions.
* Experience leading teams across the United States, Mexico, Asia, and/or Latin America.
* Previous plant leadership experience required.
* Residential or commercial building-products experience—or closely related durable-goods experience—preferred.
* Demonstrated results reducing cost, improving profit, streamlining operations, and producing sustained financial improvement.
* Expertise in lean manufacturing, global supply chain strategy, SIOP, sourcing, logistics, quality, productivity, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to operate effectively in an ERP environment.
* Strong collaboration, communication, conflict-management, executive-presence, and influencing skills.
* Strong business judgment, commercial acumen, learning agility, and comfort operating amid ambiguity and change.
* Hands-on, proactive leadership style that balances strategy and innovation with practical, accelerated execution.
* Fact-based and metrics-driven decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to develop leaders, strengthen succession pipelines, and upgrade organizational capability.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.

*At Broan NuTone, we take pride in offering exceptional benefit packages and a highly competitive pay structure to our employees. Our comprehensive benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, company paid life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, wellness program, education assistance, parental leave, and employee assistance programs. In addition, we provide a competitive pay structure that rewards our employees for their hard work and dedication, ensuring that they are compensated fairly for their contributions. Join our team and enjoy the peace of mind and financial stability that comes with our outstanding benefits and competitive pay.*
